Query.Sql: select patient_identifier_value, clinical_date, clinical_datetime, clinical_code, replace(upper(trim(clinical_code)), '.', '') as concept_code from ##duckdb_source## where upper(trim(clinical_code_system)) = 'OPCS4'

Explanation.Description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.
Clinical procedure date. Missing dates produce invalid procedure records.
Original procedure code, preserved as the source value.
Uppercase, trimmed OPCS4 code with dots removed for the existing OPCS4 resolver. Only Procedure-domain targets are retained.
